versions.changelog:
Version 2.1.0 introduces expanded tool coverage and new admin capabilities.

- Added `users_me` (identity check) to read-only tools.
- Increased tool counts per privilege tier (now 7/13/18).
- Introduced new admin features: database update and dedicated page-move endpoint.
- Updated description and listed current API (v0.4) support.

v2.0.1: metadata fix — requires.env reduced to [NOTION_TOKEN] only. Audit-log / admin-log / admin-confirm envs are opt-in per workflow, not required (matches the read-first default tier). Addresses OpenClaw scanner suspicious.llm_suspicious on v2.0.0.

v2 major: three-tier MCP (--allow-admin), admin lifecycle (db create, ds update, ds add-relation, page move), CLI-only users/comments, tristate icon/cover, two-sink audit log, TTY confirm, PropertySchema typing (BREAKING). Tracks notion-cli-mcp crate v0.3.0.
Declared NOTION_TOKEN in requires.env metadata. Removed curl|sh installer from runtime instructions (kept crates.io install only; alternate channels documented with checksums in the project README).

notion-cli-mcp 1.0.0

- Initial release providing Notion access via a Rust CLI and MCP stdio server.
- Implements native support for Notion API (2025-09-03+) data-source model, with 22 property types and 12 block types.
- Agent-safety features: output envelope, 3 req/s rate limit, auth token scrubbing, 10 MiB response cap, and JSONL audit log.
- Read-only by default; write operations require explicit enablement and are logged.
- Includes structured exit codes, detailed error hints, and comprehensive dry-run validation with --check-request.
- Full tool and usage documentation included.
